description: This file defines the DocumentsController class for managing document-related HTTP API endpoints in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting Document entities with database persistence, authorization, and auditing features.

classes.name: DocumentsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling document-related API endpoints, utilizing dependency injection for database context and implementing CRUD operations with authorization and auditing.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to create a new document, setting the creator user ID from context.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve all documents, includes authorization attribute for admin roles.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve a specific document by ID, with support for 200 OK and 404 Not Found responses.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update an existing document identified by ID.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE request to remove a document by ID, applies an audit attribute, and returns appropriate HTTP status.
